news.title: Meta settles social media addiction case with California, other states for $16.7 billion
news.summary: Meta and state attorneys general settled a federal trial centering on allegations that company misrepresented the extent of child-related mental health harms.

news.title: Fed, NASA and DOJ among victims of Chinese state-sponsored hacker group: Court documents
news.summary: Hackers targeted networks "operated by hospitals, telecommunications providers, power companies, financial institutions, and defense contractors," a filing said.

news.title: The post-penny economy: How cash rounding and credit card surcharges are changing what you pay
news.summary: More merchants are rounding change for cash purchases to the nearest nickel due to the end of penny production, or adding surcharges to credit card transactions.

news.title: Bahçıvan: Ekonomik program sanayinin üretken kapasitesini koruyacak şekilde güçlendirilmeli
news.summary: İSO Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Erdal Bahçıvan, mevcut ekonomik programın sanayinin üretken kapasitesini koruyacak, kırılganlıklarını azaltacak ve teknolojik dönüşümünü destekleyecek bütüncül bir yol haritasıyla güçlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtti.

news.title: New York borsası karışık seyirle açıldı

news.title: Lost in limbo: Where the Paramount merger delay leaves WBD, and what may come next
news.summary: Paramount Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery is stalled due to an antitrust lawsuit, leaving WBD in limbo during a pivotal moment for media.
